methodology: Each of 30 content turns compared by proposition against source text available on the Vatican's published historical document pages, Museo San Pio X's 1905/Salzano digital transcriptions, or the translated Quam singulari reprint. No facsimile-level autographic collation or bilingual native-editor certification. Negative boundary sentences are metadata decisions, not attributed as spoken by St Pius X. Post-audit source-first voice editing of all 23 character drafts made no new original-language quotation claim; retargeted Communion-day follow-up explicitly to Q508.
evidenceSources: Museo San Pio X: 1905 catechism Q527–533 and Q667–669
Museo San Pio X: Salzano Q506–508 and Q541–543
The Holy See: Tra le sollecitudini §§1–5
Quam singulari translated decree rules 1–4, explicit papal approval
releaseRules: No new claim outside the named primary passage is silently upgraded to a papal assertion.
Anachronistic temporal/legal judgments and editorial source insufficiency are non-character notes.
The two intentionally held personal cases (#11/12) remain outside the playable ten.
Source text supports thematic propositions; no exact historical spoken quotation is claimed.
Independent theological and bilingual reviewer decisions must follow this audit.
